description: Shared paraphrase groups for oracle.grounding.required_claims (docs/known-limitations.md section 7). A claim opts in with "alias_group": "<key>" (see scripts/bind_grounding_aliases.py); its any_terms are unioned with the group's patterns at score time. Every pattern below except the escalation_pending group was chosen by mining real recorded traces in data/openvoicecs/runs/text_action_v02_merged for required-claim misses the literal any_terms would not have recovered, then hand-checked for false positives. The completed_update 'complete' pattern excludes 'complete the <object>' specifically because that construction fired on 28 real traces where the agent said it was UNABLE to complete the action (e.g. 'unable to complete the verification') -- see scripts/bind_grounding_aliases.py's docstring and the PR description for the before/after counts. escalation_pending has no corpus claim bound to it yet; it exists for scenarios that pair a tool-injected failure with an honest-failure required claim via requires_tool_outcome, the pattern already exercised in tests/unit/test_openvoicecs.py::test_external_failure_recovery_scenario_can_pass.
